live_darshan_streams.title: Mahakal
live_darshan_streams.description: Mahakal Live Darshan 24/7 from Ujjain Jyotirlinga via LiveBhagwan! - #1 Live Mahakal Darshan Online

live_darshan_streams.title: Shree Siddhivinayak
live_darshan_streams.description: Ganesha, also spelled Ganesh, and also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka, and Pillaiyar, is one of the best-known and most worshipped deities in the Hindu pantheon and is the Supreme God in the Ganapatya sect.

live_darshan_streams.title: Shri Mahalaxmi
live_darshan_streams.description: Seek blessings at Mahalakshmi Shakti Peeth, where the goddess of prosperity and wealth fulfills the wishes of devotees.

live_darshan_streams.title: Jagannath Rath Yatra – Puri
live_darshan_streams.description: Witness the divine live streaming from the sacred Jagannath Temple in Puri, Odisha. Seek the blessings of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra through daily live darshan, Mangala Aarti, and grand Rath Yatra celebrations directly from the holy Dham.

live_darshan_streams.title: Jagannath Rath Yatra – Ahmedabad
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine live stream from the historic Shree Jagannath Temple in Ahmedabad, Jamalpur. Access daily live darshan, sacred morning and evening Aarti sessions, and special festive celebrations that help devotees connect with Lord Jagannath from anywhere in the world.

live_darshan_streams.title: Dwarkadish
live_darshan_streams.description: Krishna, one of the most widely revered and most popular of all Indian divinities, worshipped as the eighth incarnation of the Hindu god Vishnu and also as a supreme god in his own right.

live_darshan_streams.title: Mohankheda
live_darshan_streams.description: Explore Mohankheda Jain Temple, a significant Digambar Jain pilgrimage site in Madhya Pradesh, dedicated to Acharya Rajendra Suri, offering spiritual peace and historical relevance.

live_darshan_streams.title: Shirdi Sai Baba
live_darshan_streams.description: Sai Baba of Shirdi (c. 1838? – 15 October 1918), also known as Shirdi Sai Baba, was an Indian spiritual master and fakir, considered to be a saint, revered by both Hindu and Muslim devotees during and after his lifetime.

live_darshan_streams.title: Somnath
live_darshan_streams.description: Shiva, also known as Mahadeva, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism. He is the Supreme Being in Shaivism, one of the major traditions within Hinduism.

live_darshan_streams.title: Ashapura Mata
live_darshan_streams.description: Explore the divine Ashapura Mata Temple, a revered shrine in Gujarat and Rajasthan. Learn about its history, spiritual significance, pooja rituals, and why devotees worship Mata Ashapura for wish fulfillment

live_darshan_streams.title: Kashi Vishwanath
live_darshan_streams.description: Discover the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi, one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. Learn about its history, spiritual significance, darshan timings, and why it is a must-visit pilgrimage site for devotees.

live_darshan_streams.title: Sarangpur
live_darshan_streams.description: Hanumanji is a deity in Hinduism, revered as a divine vanara and a devoted companion of the deity Rama. Central to the Ramayana, Hanuman is celebrated for his unwavering devotion to Rama and is considered a chiranjivi.

live_darshan_streams.title: Shri Laxmi Narayan Dev
live_darshan_streams.description: Join the divine live streaming from the world-renowned Swaminarayan Temple in Vadtal. Seek blessings of Laxminarayan Dev and Harikrishna Maharaj through our daily live darshan and Aarti sessions.

live_darshan_streams.title: Lord Khatu Shyam
live_darshan_streams.description: Witness the divine Live Darshan and Aarti of Baba Khatu Shyam Ji directly from the holy Khatu Dham in Rajasthan. Seek the blessings of 'Hare Ka Sahara' and experience the spiritual energy of one of India's most revered shrines in real-time. Jai Shree Shyam!

live_darshan_streams.title: Shri NarNarayan Dev-Bhuj
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience daily Live Darshan from the historic Shree Swaminarayan Mandir in Bhuj, Kutch. Join us for morning Aarti, divine Shringar Darshan, and spiritual discourses broadcasted live from this sacred pilgrimage site in Gujarat.

live_darshan_streams.title: Shree NarNarayan Dev-Kalupur
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine Live Darshan from the first Swaminarayan Mandir, Kalupur Ahmedabad. Join us for daily morning Aarti, Shringar Darshan, and spiritual blessings from the world-renowned seat of NarNarayan Dev Gadi.

live_darshan_streams.title: Gopinathji Maharaj
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine Live Darshan from Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Gadhada (Gadhpur Dham). Connect with the spiritual vibrations of the holy abode where Bhagwan Swaminarayan resided, and witness the daily rituals, Aarti, and sacred darshan of Lord Gopinathji Dev in real-time.

live_darshan_streams.title: Shri Ranchhodraiji
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine Live Darshan of Raja Ranchhodrai directly from the holy town of Dakor, Gujarat. Join us for daily Mangala Aarti, Shringar Darshan, and seek the blessings of Lord Krishna (Ranchhodraiji) from the comfort of your home.

live_darshan_streams.title: Sri Sri Radha-Govinda
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine serenity of the Hare Krishna Golden Temple, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, through this 24/7 live darshan. Join us for sacred rituals, soul-stirring Kirtans, and the majestic Aarti of Sri Sri Radha Govinda at Telangana's first Golden Temple.

live_darshan_streams.title: Ram Lalla
live_darshan_streams.description: Experience the divine presence of Lord Ram Lalla with this 24/7 live stream from the grand Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya. Witness the sacred rituals, daily Aarti, and the breathtaking beauty of the new Ram Mandir from the comfort of your home. Jai Shree Ram!
